title: Kanagavel Kaaka
desc: After witnessing the rich being set free despite committing various crimes, Kanagavel decides to take matters into his own hands.

title: Captain
desc: Kannayiram, a powerful gangster, kills Ramasamy, for not giving up his land to him. After hearing this news, Shiva, Ramasamy's brother, flees the military camp to avenge his brother's death.

title: Mitta Miraasu
desc: Chellaiya is hell-bent on taking revenge on his uncle Masilamani and his two sons for backstabbing his father. However, things are not as easy as they seem.

title: Kannedhirey Thondrinal
desc: Vasanth learns that the girl he is in love with is his close friend Shankar's sister. When Shankar shares his bitter past with Vasanth, he decides to sacrifice his love to protect his friendship.

title: Anwar
desc: Circumstances force Anwar to join a terrorist organisation. However, things change when he double-crosses them to avenge the death of his family.

title: Vetri Mugam
desc: Sumathi shifts to a new locality and starts teasing Arvind, a talented painter, who is always depressed. After learning about his past, she decides to make him change his perspective about love.

title: Shakthi
desc: Shakti, an undercover government agent, is forced to reveal his real identity after he saves a minister's daughter who gets pursued by thugs in search of a mysterious stone.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Thendral
desc: A young girl grows up harbouring a crush for her favourite writer. However, things get complicated when they both meet and she ends up getting pregnant.
